description: The backup.failed event, the engine's twin of finished, emitted on every failure AND every refusal the run meets (a lock-held refusal is a failed event with its kind, because the schedule's subscriber needs to know the tick did not land): reason and actor (the ledger's pair), the closed-set error_kind a client can branch on, and the stage the run was at. The sentence stays on the door that was refused; the event carries the enum, daemon-wide, ids/enums/numbers only.
